import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
houston = ee.Geometry.Point([-95.3698, 29.7604])  # Houston, TX coordinates
buffer_size = 20000  # 20km buffer for city area
houston_area = houston.buffer(buffer_size)

# 2. Data Acquisition for April 2024 (Monthly)
monthly_col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') \
    .filterBounds(houston_area) \
    .filterDate('2024-04-01', '2024-05-01')

april_size = monthly_col.size().getInfo()
print(f"April 2024 monthly images: {april_size}")

if april_size == 0:
    print("No April 2024 data available.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 3. Data Acquisition for May 18, 2024 (Daily)
daily_col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/DAILY_V1') \
    .filterBounds(houston_area) \
    .filterDate('2024-05-18', '2024-05-19')

may_size = daily_col.size().getInfo()
print(f"May 18, 2024 daily images: {may_size}")

if may_size == 0:
    print("No May 18, 2024 data available.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 4. Processing April 2024
april_img = monthly_col.first().select('avg_rad')
april_count = april_img.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=houston_area,
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('avg_rad').getInfo()

if april_count == 0:
    print("No valid pixels for April 2024.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    exit()

april_mean = april_img.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry=houston_area,
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('avg_rad').getInfo()

# 5. Processing May 18, 2024
may_img = daily_col.first().select('DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m')
may_count = may_img.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=houston_area,
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m').getInfo()

if may_count == 0:
    print("No valid pixels for May 18, 2024.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    exit()

may_mean = may_img.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry=houston_area,
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m').getInfo()

# 6. Validation & Final Answer
print(f"April 2024 avg intensity: {april_mean:.4f} (Pixels: {int(april_count)})")
print(f"May 18, 2024 intensity: {may_mean:.4f} (Pixels: {int(may_count)})")

if april_mean is None or may_mean is None:
    print("Calculation failed - None result.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif april_mean < 0 or may_mean < 0:
    print("Invalid negative radiance values.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif may_mean < april_mean:
    print("May 18 intensity decreased compared to April avg.")
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("May 18 intensity did not decrease.")
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
